static_scan: no medium or high Bandit findings
findings: Core library has no subprocess or shell execution path.
Core library stores no files; diagnostic output is opt-in.
Credentials and cloud tokens are held in memory during a process.
auto_refresh retains username/password in a closure; local adapter disables it.
Library is unofficial and depends on iRobot, Gigya, AWS Cognito, AWS IoT, and REST services.
Downloaded map bundles are parsed in memory and are not extracted to disk.
No blind authentication retry loop was found; local adapter performs one initial login attempt.
A nonsecret macOS Keychain write/read/delete canary passed; secrets are supplied over stdin rather than argv.
Release tag is unsigned, so installation is pinned to the verified commit object rather than trusting the tag alone.
verdict: acceptable for isolated read-only pilot with Keychain credentials and no optional command tools
